summary: Rectitude Holdings Ltd., a Singapore-based safety equipment provider listed on Nasdaq under RECT, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, announcing a cash dividend of US$0.10 per ordinary share. The dividend totals US$1,548,275 across 15,482,750 ordinary shares outstanding. The record date is September 7, 2026, with payment on September 21, 2026. CEO Zhang Jian cited strong fundamentals and disciplined growth. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation requiring further structural analysis. Watch for continued consistent dividend declarations or potential changes in payout policy.
